lean.name: QuantumComputationSpecs.Algorithms.Grover:QuantumComputation.Specs.groverParallelMarkingOracle
lean.plain: Parallel marking oracle in the challenge
lean.annotation: A slot can be disabled without knowing any unmarked address. Since $X|+\rangle=|+\rangle$, the oracle acts as the identity on that slot whenever its target qubit is prepared in $|+\rangle$. This also works when its address is entangled with the rest of the workspace.

lean.name: QuantumComputationDiscoveries.Algorithms.GroverFindAny:QuantumComputation.Specs.groverParallelMarkingOracle
lean.plain: Parallel marking oracle in Find-Any
lean.annotation: The Find-Any solution uses the same product of embedded single-slot unitaries. The input is one shared state of the $m$ slots, so its addresses may be entangled across slots.

lean.name: ResourceCounting.CostModel.ofEmbeddedOracle
lean.plain: Charging one round per embedded oracle
lean.annotation: `ofEmbeddedOracle` charges one round for a unitary assignment exactly when its matrix equals the full oracle embedded on some register, and zero otherwise. An assignment that happens to equal an embedded oracle is charged too, regardless of how it was constructed.

lean.name: ResourceCounting.expectedCost
lean.plain: Cost weighted by branch probability
lean.annotation: If one query is followed by a second on an outcome of probability $1/4$, the expected cost is $1+1/4$ rounds. In `expectedCost`, the state passed to the second query already has trace $1/4$, so the `.qAssign` case multiplies its unit cost by $1/4$.

lean.name: ResourceCounting.whileRecCost_succ
lean.plain: One-step recurrence for guarded-loop cost
lean.annotation: `whileRecCost_succ` charges the current body on the guard-restricted state, then computes the remaining prefix cost on the state produced by that body. For a trace-one input, if every entered iteration reaches exactly one unit-charge oracle call, the first $L$ unrollings cost $\sum_{r=0}^{L-1}\Pr(T>r)$ in expectation, where $T$ counts entered iterations, including the successful one if there is one.

lean.name: QuantumComputationSpecs.Algorithms.Grover:QuantumComputation.Specs.groverParallelMarkingOracle
lean.plain: Parallel marking oracle in the challenge
lean.annotation: `groverParallelMarkingOracle` embeds O_S on each of m disjoint (n+1)-qubit slots and multiplies the embedded operators, giving O_S^⊗m on the oracle register. The operator factors across slots; the shared input state need not.

lean.annotation: With every marker in |−⟩, the product oracle gives an ordered address tuple the phase (−1)^(∑ⱼ[xⱼ∈S]). It counts marked slots, not distinct marked addresses: two copies of the same marked address contribute a net sign of +1.

lean.name: ResourceCounting.expectedCost
lean.plain: Cost weighted by branch probability
lean.annotation: For each unitary assignment, `expectedCost` multiplies the charge by the trace of its input state. In a loop, that state descends from the part satisfying the classical guard, so the trace carries the probability of reaching this round.

lean.name: ResourceCounting.whileRecCost_succ
lean.plain: One-step recurrence for guarded-loop cost
lean.annotation: The recursion restricts the state to outcomes satisfying the guard before evaluating the body cost. It passes the body’s output from those outcomes into the next unrolling.
